# Model card — `winter311-hgb-v1` (run `v2-8d19aa86`)

- **Status:** `enabled = false` · active layer: **heuristic**
- **Target:** P(>=1 winter-related 311 report in H3 res-9 cell within next 24h). This is reporting behaviour, **not** ice, snow depth or sidewalk safety.
- **Data:** Ville de Montréal 311 requests (CC BY 4.0), file sha256 `8d19aa86ebc17270697883bcc3d0f746b381899501a5dc8967477bd6d49de8bb`; ECCC climate-daily stations 7025251 + 702S006.
- **Window:** panel 2022-02-01 … 2026-04-30 (Nov–Apr only). Train winters [2021, 2022, 2023] · calibration winter 2024 · test winter 2025.
- **Coverage:** 2930 H3 res-9 cells (City of Montréal boroughs; any geolocated 311 request before 2024-11-01). Spatial holdout: 5 H3 res-6 blocks.
- **Rows:** {'train': 929764, 'valid': 372317, 'test_chrono': 372317, 'test_spatial': 158013} · positives {'train': 20675, 'valid': 10608, 'test_chrono': 11356, 'test_spatial': 3607}.
- **Algorithm:** sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier (fixed hyper-parameters) + isotonic calibration on the validation winter.
- **Precision/recall@k:** top 50 cells per day, pooled over test days. PR-AUC on uncalibrated scores; Brier on calibrated probabilities.

## Limitations

- Predicts whether a winter-related 311 REPORT will be filed in a ~0.1 km² H3 cell on a day; it does not measure ice, snow or sidewalk safety.
- Reports reflect who reports and where (reporting bias); low predicted values do not mean a sidewalk is cleared or safe.
- Weather features use observed values from the previous days at one airport station (ECCC 7025251/702S006); same-day forecasts are not used.
- Trained on winters 2021-22 (partial) to 2023-24; evaluated on 2025-26. Behaviour under new city operations or reporting channels is untested.
- Coverage = cells in the City of Montréal's 19 boroughs with 311 activity before 2024-11-01; demerged municipalities (e.g. Westmount, Mont-Royal) are not in this 311 dataset and return unknown.
